checks: Answers MOQ with 500 pieces; minimum refers to quantity not temperature, and ordering lunch is not purchasing MOQ. English options, zh-TW and each rationale checked; offline ASR and editorial review, not runtime acceptance.

activeQuestion.prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
activeQuestion.promptZh: 聆聽問題或陳述，選出最合適的回應。

options.text: Yes, it says five hundred pieces.
options.whyZh: 直接確認有最低數量並指出報價中的數字。
minimum 雖重複出現，這裡問的是訂購量而非溫度。
order 在此指採購，不是點餐。

activeQuestion.explanationZh: 直接確認有最低數量並指出報價中的數字。
activeQuestion.evidence: Does this quotation include a minimum order quantity?

vocabulary.note: 報價或供貨條件中要求的一次最低訂購數量，常縮寫為 MOQ。

group.title: MOQ explanation
group.passage:
Does this quotation include a minimum order quantity?
A. Yes, it says five hundred pieces.
B. The minimum temperature was low.
C. We ordered lunch already.
